name: ember
description: A dark skin for old.reddit.com in Firefox, with colored comment threads

scripts.lint: oxlint -c oxlintrc.json --tsconfig tsconfig.json --type-aware src scripts test && node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext lint --source-dir dist --self-hosted
scripts.sign: node scripts/build.mjs && WEB_EXT_API_KEY=${WEB_EXT_API_KEY:-$(security find-generic-password -s amo-jwt-issuer -w)} WEB_EXT_API_SECRET=${WEB_EXT_API_SECRET:-$(security find-generic-password -s amo-jwt-secret -w)} web-ext sign --source-dir dist --channel unlisted
